```{r}
#| echo: false
layers_path <- here::here("eda", "layers_wide.csv")
layers <- data.table::fread(layers_path)

summary(layers)

layers_facs <- c("model", "lang", "test")

as.data.table(layers)
layers[, names(.SD) := lapply(.SD, as_factor), .SDcols = layers_facs]
# should layers also be considered factors?

layers_long <- layers |> pivot_longer(c(auc_last, auc_after), names_to = "position", values_to = "auc")

layers_sum <- layers |> group_by(model, params_b, test) |> summarise(auc = mean(auc_last))
```

```{r}
plt_sum <- layers_sum |> aes(x = params_b, y = auc, shape = model, color = test)
plt <- ggplot2::ggplot(data = layers_sum, mapping = plt_sum) + geom_point()
plt
```
```{r}
plt_int <- layers_long |> ggplot()
plt_int_plt <- plt_int + geom_line(aes(depth, auc, colour = model)) + geom_hline(yintercept = .5, linetype = 2) + facet_wrap(~test) + facet_grid(test ~ position) # + geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo_last, ymax = hi_last, fill = model), alpha = .15) # this doesn't work
plt_int_plt
```
